description: This file provides low-level hardware I/O routines for reading and writing data of various sizes (8, 16, 32 bits) in little-endian and big-endian formats, primarily using inline assembly for PowerPC architecture. It defines functions like in_8, out_8, in_le16, out_be16, etc., for direct memory-mapped I/O operations, and includes synchronization primitives like sync, eieio, and barrier.

methods.name: uint8_t in_8(const volatile uint8_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from a hardware register address.

methods.name: void out_8(volatile uint8_t * addr,uint8_t val)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to a hardware register address.

methods.name: uint16_t in_le16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit little-endian value from hardware.

methods.name: uint16_t in_be16(const volatile uint16_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit big-endian value from hardware.

methods.name: void out_le16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit little-endian value to hardware.

methods.name: void out_be16(volatile uint16_t * addr,uint16_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit big-endian value to hardware.

methods.name: uint32_t in_le32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit little-endian value from hardware.

methods.name: uint32_t in_be32(const volatile uint32_t * addr)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit big-endian value from hardware.

methods.name: void out_le32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit little-endian value to hardware.

methods.name: void out_be32(volatile uint32_t * addr,uint32_t val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit big-endian value to hardware.

methods.name: void sync(void)
methods.description: Issues a synchronization barrier to ensure memory operations complete.

methods.name: void eieio(void)
methods.description: Issues an 'eieio' instruction for ordering of I/O operations on PowerPC.

ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_8(volatile uint8_t *addr, uint8_t val)$/

ctags.pattern: /^static inline void out_le16(volatile uint16_t *addr, uint16_t val)$/
